'''2007 North Dakota State Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 28 July 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2007 North Dakota State Championship.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Site:''' North Dakota
* '''Dates:''' 28 July 2007
* '''Winner:''' —
